title: Train and Evaluate a Tiny PPO Joint Controller
summary: A policy loss is only one part of reinforcement learning.

frames: Declared normalized action/feature coordinates; no implicit frame conversion

units.values: Normalized joint position q; normalized velocity action units per second; dt=0.1 seconds; Gaussian action standard deviation0.2 normalized velocity units.

physical_contract.axes: noise(I,B,T), goals(B), theta(2), held-out goals(M); returned policy/history and evaluation traces
physical_contract.timestamp_assumptions: Fixed-step synthetic episodes reset q=0 each training iteration and held-out evaluation. The T-step horizon is a true terminal.
physical_contract.batching: noise(I,B,T), goals(B), theta(2), held-out goals(M); returned policy/history and evaluation traces

provenance.authoring_notes: Original executable PPO training loop for a scalar integrator and linear Gaussian controller. It omits neural perception, a critic network, entropy bonus, MuJoCo and real hardware; it is not a VLA or a reproduction of published locomotion scores.
